en: A black-and-white image showing a large cobblestone public square surrounded by historic European-style buildings. On the left is a row of multi-story buildings with shop signs, and on the right is a large building with a steep gabled roof and an exterior staircase with foliage. In the background, a larger, formal-looking building with regular windows and an arched gateway dominates the square. A fountain can be seen in the middle right. There are a few people walking and a bicyclist, all dressed in early-20th-century European-style clothing. The visible signs are in German.
